description: Widens a domain a column is typed by. A retype has no in-place form, so the domain must be dropped and recreated, and no engine will drop a type out from under a column. The plan says so rather than rendering a drop that fails part-way through the apply. The free case, where nothing is typed by the domain, is domain-retype.

postgres.because: The domain cannot be recreated while parts.reference is typed by it; the plan reports recreate-blocked-by-dependents.

sqlserver.because: The domain cannot be recreated while parts.reference is typed by it; the plan reports recreate-blocked-by-dependents.

sqlite.because: SQLite has no domain type, so the scenario's bootstrap state cannot be expressed.
